title: Broken Hill Mosque
geometryBasis: The four exact OpenStreetMap controls from the NSW base map bound the principal mosque. The exact Qualla photo distinguishes the high prayer-room roof and lower anteroom.
sectionBasis: The frozen 256 m source field anchors the common timber floor and raised threshold. Roof heights and the attached anteroom break are estimated from the verified exterior.
limitations: The red cladding and main hipped roof follow the exact published photo. The approach channel, anteroom section and windows partly obscured by vegetation are approximate.
The separate relocated West Camel Camp mosque, museum exhibits, landscaping, and vegetation are outside the principal building scope.
